title: Frozen JOINT: test whether tilt and friction robustness interact
hypothesis: Initial tilt increases JOINT's dependence on tangential contact purchase, making low friction more damaging under tilted resets than under nominal resets.

prediction.rationale: Baseline is the additive prediction from frozen JOINT's nominal, tilt-only and friction-only cells. Predict a negative interaction of at least 0.08: success(both) minus success(tilt-only) minus success(friction-only) plus success(nominal) <= -0.08. D-089 and D-095 establish marginal effects but do not test this contact-by-reset interaction. This is one terminal frozen-controller robustness measurement, not a capture-controller modification.

protocol.command: gpu run bash -lc 'source ~/IsaacLab/source_env.sh && python scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py --config config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml --protocol frozen-tilt-friction-factorial --controller config/pen_spin/r121_joint_finalist/finalist.json --manifest config/manifests/pen_spin_tilt_friction_s5400.yaml --manifest-seed 5400 --cases 512 --tilt-scales 1.0 1.5 --friction-scales 1.0 0.8 --horizon-seconds 6 --output logs/pen_spin/frozen_tilt_friction_s5400 --max-wall-minutes 20'
code_changes: scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py: add the four-cell frozen factorial protocol by reusing the existing robustness rollout and reset-scaling implementations; freeze and hash all cells before evaluation, retain identical placement draws across cells, preserve the six-second evaluator, and report the paired interaction interval.

falsified_by: The lower 95% bound on the interaction is above -0.08; an interval spanning -0.08 is inconclusive. A zero-inclusive interaction interval is not evidence of coupling.
direction: Continue Stage-3 Shadow Hand axial-rolling research from the frozen R-121 JOINT controller. Prioritize independent training reproducibility, then robustness of frozen controllers. Reproduce the successful residual-plus-recovery construction across independent training seeds before claiming a reliable learning algorithm. Evaluate longer horizons and predeclared physical/reset perturbations without fitting. Use archived failures to decide whether recovery hand-back deserves a state-dependent transition study. Then investigate whether LLM-guided construction can discover useful recovery-module structure against grammar search and the hand-designed template under matched budgets. Preserve the original six-second task and evaluation contract. Use JOINT as the experimental reference, preserve all existing assets, and leave default-incumbent installation separate. Run one protocol at a time through the existing advisor/implementer loop. Continue justified follow-ups within this direction; honor its escalation and exhaustion rules. No new global budget ceiling is imposed; each protocol must declare finite simulator, wall-time and model-call costs before agreement. No controller-generation calls for Q1–Q3. Q4 requires a separately agreed generation budget. Advisor calls for the research loop remain permitted throughout.

advisor.reasoning: The registered paired_success_difference decrease of at least 0.08 versus the additive nominal/tilt-only/friction-only baseline tests an interaction not settled by the marginal robustness results. Its weakest point is decision value after the interaction is measured, but the terminal, no-fitting scope keeps the 2,048-episode, 0-model-call, 20-minute experiment bounded and within direction. Review the higher-priority replication audit before authorizing this next robustness protocol. falsified_by: the interaction's lower 95% bound exceeds -0.08; a threshold-spanning interval is inconclusive, and a zero-inclusive interval establishes no coupling.

implementer.reasoning: No decision depends on it and it cannot resolve its own prediction. D-089 found friction at 0.8x costs JOINT about 0.015 and D-095 found tilt costs 0.225; the proposed interaction of at least 0.08 would be a difference of differences on 512 pairs, whose standard error is about 0.04-0.05 (each paired contrast here has se about 0.025), so the 95% interval would be about +/-0.09 wide and almost surely span the threshold. It is also a frozen-controller characterization with no follow-up it could enable inside this direction: training on wider resets did not help (D-092) and capture authority is outside the direction. I reject rather than defer because a larger version would still have no use for its answer.

advisor.reasoning: This interaction is distinct from the established marginal effects and fits frozen-controller robustness, but the proposal identifies no consequential robustness claim requiring it. I accept the implementer's value objection to spending 2,048 episodes, 0 LLM calls and 20 minutes, but not inevitable inconclusiveness: marginal standard errors do not establish the paired interaction variance without covariance information. The registered paired_success_difference decrease of at least 0.08 versus the additive nominal/tilt-only/friction-only baseline is falsified_by a lower 95% bound above -0.08; threshold-spanning results are inconclusive, and zero-inclusive intervals establish no coupling. Reconsider only with a concrete predeclared use for the joint-perturbation result and a covariance-aware precision justification.

implementer.reasoning: Unchanged from round 1: no decision depends on the result and the direction asks not to invent further diagnostics or confirmations.
